title: The Passage Hotel
victim: Markus Stein, the guest in room seven
teaser: The guest in room seven ordered tea at midnight, but nobody answered the knock. The night porter insists no one left through the lobby, yet the back stairs are covered in wet footprints. One visitor seems to have come in from the street, and another was already waiting inside.
locations: The boiler room in the cellar

habits.label: Soot under the nails
clues: The white tray with the cold tea in room seven has black prints of coal dust on it. The culprit has soot under their nails.
The banister of the back stairs is smudged grey with soot all the way from the cellar to the third floor. The culprit has coal soot under their nails.

habits.label: Black bowler hat
habits.habit: A black bowler hat, even indoors
clues: A black bowler hat full of rainwater was found behind a chimney on the roof. The culprit wears a bowler hat.
The waiter remembers a black bowler at a back table in the restaurant that stayed on until midnight. The culprit wears a bowler hat.

habits.label: Anchor tattoo
habits.habit: A blue anchor on the back of the hand
clues: The chambermaid saw a hand with a blue anchor reach for a stack of towels in the linen room. The culprit has an anchor tattoo on their hand.
The doorman describes the hand that slipped him a coin by the back stairs: it had a blue anchor on it. The culprit has an anchor tattoo.

habits.label: Morse code
clues: Dots and dashes are pencilled on the blotter in room seven. The culprit knows Morse code.
Someone scratched a row of dots and dashes on a pipe in the boiler room, a signal of some kind. The culprit knows Morse code.

habits.label: Brilliantined hair
clues: There's a greasy stain of brilliantine on the pillow in room seven, and Stein's hair is grey and dry. The culprit wears brilliantine.
A stack of clean towels in the linen room has a stain that smells of brilliantine. The culprit slicks their hair with brilliantine.

habits.label: Tea through a sugar lump
habits.habit: Drinks tea only through a lump of sugar
clues: There are two glasses on the tray in room seven, and next to one is a little pile of bitten sugar lumps. The culprit sips tea through a sugar lump.
The cook was surprised that the midnight tea for room seven came with a request for lump sugar instead of cubes. The culprit sips tea through a sugar lump.

habits.label: Gold tooth
habits.habit: A gold crown on a canine
clues: All the night porter remembers is a smile with a gold tooth flashing in it. The culprit has a gold crown.
The waiter says someone asked about room seven with a smile that showed a gold canine. The culprit has a gold tooth.

habits.label: Leica camera
habits.habit: A Leica camera on a strap
clues: A lens cap lies on the carpet in room seven. The culprit carries a camera.
An empty Leica film cassette was found by the parapet on the roof. The culprit carries a Leica.

habits.label: Polka-dot bow tie
clues: A silk bow tie with white polka dots lies behind a basket in the linen room. The culprit wears a bow tie.
The waiter remembers a polka-dot bow tie at the restaurant door and nothing else. The culprit wears a polka-dot bow tie.

habits.label: Plays chess
clues: A game is set out on the table in room seven, and the last move was made by someone else's hand. The culprit plays chess.
A restaurant napkin has the move "Qe7, check" written on it, with the time: a quarter to twelve. The culprit plays chess.

habits.label: Dog hair
habits.habit: Clothes covered in ginger dog hair
clues: The armchair in room seven has ginger dog hairs on it, and dogs aren't allowed in the hotel. The culprit's clothes are covered in dog hair.
Tufts of ginger hair are stuck to the wet steps of the back stairs. The culprit's clothes are covered in dog hair.

habits.label: Missing fingertip
habits.habit: Missing the top joint of the little finger
clues: On the misted window of room seven there's a palm print with a little finger shorter than it should be. The culprit is missing a fingertip.
A starched sheet in the linen room bears the print of a hand without the tip of the little finger. The culprit is missing the top of their little finger.

habits.label: Spins a coin
habits.habit: Rolls a coin between the fingers
clues: A silver coin worn shiny from constant handling lies on the back-stairs landing. The culprit rolls a coin between their fingers.
The restaurant tablecloth has round dents in it, as if a coin had been spun on it for ages. The culprit spins a coin in their fingers.

habits.label: Collects stamps
clues: A rare stamp has been carefully steamed off an envelope on the desk in room seven. The culprit collects stamps.
A clear album sleeve holding a single Danzig stamp lies on the floor of the linen room. The culprit collects postage stamps.

habits.label: White spats
clues: A white button from a spat is stuck on a wet step of the back stairs. The culprit wears spats.
The doorman saw white spats on the fire escape leading to the roof. The culprit wears white spats.

habits.label: Red hair
clues: There's a red hair on the collar of Stein's dressing gown, and Stein went grey long ago. The culprit has red hair.
A long red hair is caught in a comb in the linen room. The culprit has red hair.

keys: Room seven was opened without force, and its key with the brass fob is hanging in the porter's pigeonhole. The culprit had keys.
The linen room is locked for the night, but in the morning it was found open with the lock intact. The culprit had keys.
sched: The tea went up to room seven at exactly midnight, in the minutes when the bellboys change shifts. The culprit knows the schedule.
The boiler room was left unattended at twelve, when the stoker has his supper break. The culprit knows the schedule.
passages: The wet footprints on the back stairs lead to a door you can't see from the street, which opens from the linen room. The culprit knows the service passages.
An old coal chute runs from the boiler room up to the roof, and there are fresh tracks in it. The culprit knows the service passages.
quiet: The guest in room six was awake but heard no footsteps and no creak of a door through the wall. The culprit moves silently.
The parquet outside room seven creaks with every step, yet the chambermaid in the linen room heard nothing. The culprit moves silently.
tools: The vent grille in room seven was taken off, all four screws undone, and put back. The culprit is handy with tools.
The bolt on the roof hatch was neatly sawn through with a hacksaw. The culprit is handy with tools.
safe: The safe in room seven is open, Stein's papers are gone, and there isn't a scratch on the lock. The culprit knows the safe combination.
An envelope Stein left for safekeeping is missing from the hotel safe behind the front desk. The culprit knows the safe combination.
strong: Stein was carried from the armchair to the bed, and he weighs close to a hundred kilos. The culprit is physically strong.
The heavy cast-iron lid of the coal hatch in the cellar was lifted by one person. The culprit is physically strong.
cash: The evening takings are missing from the restaurant till, yet the bills are totted up without a single mistake. The culprit had access to money.
According to the cash book, Stein was paid an advance at midnight, but there's no envelope in his room and the signature is forged. The culprit had access to money.
perfume: Room seven smells of heavy musky perfume, and Stein lived alone. The culprit wears heavy perfume.
A thick, sweet scent lingers on the banister of the back stairs. The culprit wears heavy perfume.
medic: The cold tea from room seven has a bitter almond taste. The culprit knows about poisons.
There's a tiny needle mark on the inside of Stein's elbow. The culprit knows about poisons.
tech: The lights on the back stairs went out at midnight, and one fuse has been unscrewed in the cellar fuse box. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
The bell wire from room seven to the lobby was cut so that the porter's lamp never lit up. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
driver: There are fresh tyre tracks on the wet cobbles by the back door, and the chauffeur sat in the restaurant all night. The culprit can drive.
The car outside the entrance has been moved to the other side of the street, and its bonnet is still warm. The culprit can drive.
french: There's a note on hotel paper in room seven: "Il est trop tard". The culprit knows French.
The order for midnight tea to room seven was sent down to the kitchen in French. The culprit knows French.
